title: KIDNEY STEW
instructions: Take a medium sized beef kidney, put on the fire in cold water with an onion, let it simmer, not boil, until tender. Cut in thin slices as large as a ten-cent piece. Put a piece of butter in frying-pan, shake some flour, let it brown, then add some of the liquor it was cooked in. Serve on toast. Veal kidney does not require so long cooking; prepare same way.
